floater.name: plus_import_settings
floater.title: BRING SETTINGS OVER FROM ANOTHER VIEWER
floater.floater.string: This is the first start of Charis Viewer. Bring your settings over from a viewer you have used? Its own files are only read, never changed.
No other viewer was found on this computer. If yours keeps its settings somewhere else (a portable install, another drive), choose its folder.
[FOLDER] holds no viewer settings (user_settings\settings.xml), or it is this viewer's own folder. Choose the folder that holds user_settings.

The settings you chose are replaced by those of [NAME], and so are your key bindings if you chose them. What they replace is kept in user_settings (settings_before_import_, key_bindings_before_import_, colors_before_import_ and so on, with the date). Your chat logs and other files stay; those you do not have yet are added. Saved logins (user names and passwords) are not brought over. Go ahead?
The files of the last import are still being copied. Wait until it is done.
Logging in: the settings cannot be brought over now. Try again once you are in-world (or from the login screen).
Bringing the settings over... The viewer may stop for a while: the shaders are made again for the new settings.
The settings are brought over. Copying the files: [COPIED] of [TOTAL]... (you can go on meanwhile)
From [NAME]: [SETTINGS] settings and [FILES] files were brought over.
The key bindings were replaced (the ones you had are kept in user_settings as key_bindings_before_import_ with the date).
[KEPT] files this viewer already had were left as they were.
[OVER] files were too big or past the limit of one import (100,000 files, 2 GB) and were not copied; the log names them.
[ERRORS] things could not be brought over; the log has the details.
Some settings (the language, the size of the text, the graphics and the like) take effect at the next start.
floater.text: Choose the viewer to bring settings over from. Its own files are only read, never changed.

button.label: Choose a folder...
button.name: btn_browse
button.tool_tip: For a viewer that is not in the list: choose its folder (the one that holds user_settings)

floater.text: Not in the list? A portable install, another drive...

check_box.label: General settings (chat, camera, movement, sound, colors, messages not to show again, ...)
check_box.name: chk_general

check_box.label: Graphics settings, graphics presets and the window's size
check_box.name: chk_graphics
check_box.tool_tip: Ticked for another Charis Viewer only: other viewers' graphics settings and presets were made for their own renderers. From a Charis Viewer, its own picture settings (ambient occlusion, glare, looks, ...) are graphics too

check_box.label: Poses, environments, dictionaries and other saved files
check_box.name: chk_files

button.label: Close
button.name: btn_close
button.tool_tip: Closes this. You can open it again from Preferences > Setup.
